summary: ESLint config ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The 12.2.1 release of this ESLint config package adds a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and then uses that runtime to execute a sibling 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle, `math_init.js`. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming (e.g., `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) that disguises the fetch/extract/execFileSync flow. `math_init.js` is a single-line Bun bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a large numeric string-array and a character-shuffling decoder. Neither file is referenced by the ESLint configuration surface and the package's declared purpose (static ESLint rules) does not require a second language runtime. Historical versions of this package ship only small ESLint rule files (index.js, plugins/node, root.js); this release adds a preinstall lifecycle hook, an obfuscated loader, and an opaque alternate-runtime payload, consistent with a maintainer-token compromise republishing a dropper under the ESLint config name. The runtime switch to Bun evades Node-only static analysis of the executed payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
